In front of me everything is vanity& Everything is in vain... I am the North Star that is nailed to the night sky and I am a guide post that has b…

Q00503_PursuitOfClanAmbition/30766-01.ht.text: Witch Cleo: I must find the leader of the brothers of blood. They are warriors united by their firm resolve and ambition. I must guide him to a priceless royal symbol of no monetary value...

Q00503_PursuitOfClanAmbition/30766-02.ht.text: Witch Cleo: Welcome leader of the resolute and anmitious brothers of blood. I have been expecting you...
when: state STARTED; memo 8000; !(qs.isCreated() || qs.isCompleted()); lqs != null; player.isClanLeader()

links.text: "Tell me about the Scepter of Judgment."

Q00503_PursuitOfClanAmbition/30766-05.ht.text: Witch Cleo: I never repeat myself. If you don't understand what I have already explained to you, go and see Sir Eric Rodemai. His family often visits me to listen to the ramblings of a crazy old woman.
when: state STARTED; memo 8100; !(qs.isCreated() || qs.isCompleted()); lqs != null; player.isClanLeader()

Q00503_PursuitOfClanAmbition/30766-06.ht.text: Witch Cleo: Did you hear what I said? Riding the waves of fate or standing against them. Although fate may be cruel regardless of which you choose, you still must make a choice.
when: state STARTED; !(qs.isCreated() || qs.isCompleted()); lqs != null; player.isClanLeader(); qs.getMemoState() > 8100

Q00503_PursuitOfClanAmbition/30766-07.ht.text: Witch Cleo: The Scepter of Judgment is desperately sought after by many of the military elite... You can trade it for something you would find much more useful. Why have you brought it to me? Can I touch it?
when: state STARTED; memo 10000; !(qs.isCreated() || qs.isCompleted()); lqs != null; player.isClanLeader(); !((qs.getMemoState() > 8100) && (qs.getMemoState() < 10000))

links.text: Show her the Scepter of Judgment

Q00503_PursuitOfClanAmbition/30766-03.ht.text: Witch Cleo: Listen carefully. There is one whose path freely traverses time and space. The holder of 6 keys, the great king of grave lookouts... If he is pierced with a two-pronged spear, he will be brought down, and then his effects shall become yours... Or if you wish, I could tell you another st…

Q00503_PursuitOfClanAmbition/30766-04.ht.text: Witch Cleo: The path of a king is rife with blood and honor, war and death, ambition and power. Soon you will know all of them well. Such has it always been and such shall it always be. Soon you will be forced to choose whether to stand against the waves of fate or to ride over them...
